Cross-vendor gate before maintainer commits are pushed to the contributor branch of gastownhall/beads PR #4896.

Context: slash and mixed-case metadata keys must be queryable. The maintainer work is a single two-parent merge commit (contributor head + upstream/main) in worktree .worktrees/beads/pr-4896-fix whose conflict resolution keeps BOTH the PR's always-quote+escape JSONMetadataPath/jsonPathEscaper AND main's #4732 MergeMetadataJSON/ApplyMetadataEdits/MetadataEditValue, plus two new end-to-end tests (TestMetadataFilterSuite/MetadataFieldMatchSlashKey and MetadataFieldMatchMixedCaseKey) through the real embedded query path, and a narrowed JSONMetadataPath doc comment (quote/backslash escaping branches are unreachable via production callers, which all pass ValidateMetadataKey first — verify that claim).

Inspect: git -C .worktrees/beads/pr-4896-fix show HEAD (merge commit; use git diff HEAD^1 HEAD and git diff HEAD^2 HEAD to see each side's delta) and surrounding source. Assess correctness of the dual-preserve resolution (no function lost, no duplicate definitions), test honesty, and whether ValidateMetadataKey genuinely gates all production callers. Read-only; post nothing; no bd/dolt commands. First line exactly 'VERDICT: SHIP' or 'VERDICT: FIX', then terse file:line bullets.

I’ll review the merge from both parents, trace every production caller of `JSONMetadataPath` through validation, and check that the two end-to-end tests exercise the embedded query path. I’ll stay read-only and won’t run any `bd`/Dolt commands or post upstream.

VERDICT: FIX

- `cmd/bd/metadata_filter_test.go:14-17,253-297` — Tests use server-backed `*dolt.DoltStore`, not `embeddeddolt`; they also pass `query=""` with a prebuilt filter, bypassing lexer/parser. The “embedded end-to-end query path” claim is overstated.
- `cmd/bd/test_helpers_test.go:52-59,121-143` — Confirms `newTestStore` connects to the shared Dolt server.
- `internal/storage/metadata.go:233-239` — Caller list is inaccurate: `ApplyMetadataEdits` never calls `JSONMetadataPath`; the omitted caller is `doltTransaction.SearchIssues` (`internal/storage/dolt/transaction.go:569-590`). All actual production call sites do validate first, so the reachability conclusion itself holds.
- `internal/storage/metadata.go:240-323` — Dual-preserve resolution is otherwise correct: exactly one definition each of `JSONMetadataPath`, `jsonPathEscaper`, `MergeMetadataJSON`, `ApplyMetadataEdits`, and `MetadataEditValue`; neither parent’s functionality was lost.
